card.name: Ends of 24-hour limits and MAOI names
card.fires_on: The last word of a phrase like "within any 24-hour period" or "in 24 hours" in one-dose-per-day limits. It also fires on "inhibitors" or "OI" ending "monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOI)".

modes.label: 24-hour dose limit
modes.description: The word completing a once-per-24-hours limit, such as period, hours or within.
modes.example: Do not administer more than one dose of eltrombopag tablets within any 24-hour<< period>>. Discontinuation: Discontinue elt

modes.label: MAO inhibitor name
modes.description: The closing word of monoamine oxidase inhibitors, or the end of MAOI, in interaction warnings.
modes.example: Concomitant use, or within 14 days of the administration, of monoamine oxidase<< inhibitors>> because of an increased risk of serotonin syndrome

card.plain: It marks the end of a "no more than one dose in 24 hours" limit and of the phrase "monoamine oxidase inhibitors" in warnings.
